title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1267: Eat you (3)

section.p: At the same time.
In the sky.

Instead of sticking together, the two furballs had separated as they approached the River of Time from two different directions. This river was connected to the Devil Realm. The Devil Pseudo Emperor could be found at the end of the river.

Unlike the Human Realm, the Devil Realm’s suppressive force was still intact. The Devil Pseudo Emperor would be very powerful in his own realm. Coupled with the suppressive force, the two furballs might not be his match after entering the realm. However, they were quite experienced in hunting.

At the moment, the big furball was speaking to the female furball through voice transmission as they approached the river, “I will reverse time later and reverse his past and future bodies out. Then, we’ll start eating…”
The female furball asked, “Can you reverse his present body out as well? We can eat everything together.”
“That will be harder. We’ll eat his past and future first before eating his present. If we can’t, so be it…”
“Alright.”
The female furball asked in excitement, “So which do we eat first? Past or future?”
“The future is stronger, but the past smells better. It’s mellow and rich in taste. The future smells rough…”
The big furball gave his opinion. The past body would always be richer in taste.

As for the future body, it would feel empty and rough as the future was not set. Eating the future felt like he was imagining it instead of actually eating the meal. The present had the best taste, but also the hardest to hunt.
“I understand. Let’s eat the past first…”

The two furballs reached an agreement. As they were hiding in the void, nobody noticed their approach. Not even the Devil Pseudo Emperor could sense their approach as they weren’t targeting his present body.
The moment he started summoning, another River of Time appeared and connected itself with the Devil Pseudo Emperor’s River of Time. With a look of excitement, the big furball started reversing time.
“Who is this?”

Mo Duona demanded. At the same time, devil qi started churning in the Devil Realm. The Devil Pseudo Emperor opened his eyes with a cold expression. A River of Time had entered the Devil Realm by attaching itself to his River of Time.
He threw a punch.
The River of Time trembled, but it persisted.
“Come!”
“Yummy, come to me…”
Reverse!
A powerful absorption force erupted near the Devil Pseudo Emperor, causing him to stagger as a weaker Devil Pseudo Emperor walked out of the body and flew toward the River of Time.
That was his past body. Someone was reversing his past.
Furious, the Devil Pseudo Emperor roared and blasted his own palace apart as he gave pursuit while roaring, “Impudent!”
Who could it be?
He looked at the other end of the river before roaring in fury, “Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor? You’re courting death!”

He did not fear the furball. Yes, the Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor was strong, but the Devil Pseudo Emperor was probably stronger. Thus, he showed no fear. He had not imagined that the Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor would be brazen enough to go after his tri-life body. How audacious.

As he chased his body, he started throwing punch after punch. He was a cultural researcher as well, but against the Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor, he opted to fight as a warrior instead of a cultural researcher.

By the time the third punch was thrown, it felt as though the world was ending. A massive crack appeared in the sky of the Devil Realm. One devil Invincible after another appeared and looked at the sky. Some were alarmed, but some were indifferent. However, all were curious about the person brazen enough to attack the Devil Pseudo Emperor.
The moment the big furball made his move, countless people saw a River of Time spreading across the sky before latching onto the Pseudo Devil Emperor’s River of Time to enter the Devil Realm.
As the big furball worked, it felt as though the entire world was going to return to the past.
“Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor!”
An Invincible beside Mo Duona exclaimed in alarm. Should they take action? That would offend a Pseudo Emperor.
But if they stayed their hands…

Before long, three devil Invincibles acted. The three were the only remaining devil Invincibles outside the ancient city. They had to act. As for the other Invincibles, none acted. This was a Pseudo Emperor of an ancient race. It would be unwise to provoke such an existence.

In any case, the Devil Pseudo Emperor would be fine. He was strong enough to handle this himself. The Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor was getting too brazen. Was he trying to eat the Devil Pseudo Emperor? What a crazy thought to have.

At this point, the big furball had emerged from the void. Wave after wave of time undulations rippled out of his white fur as he used all his strength to pull the Devil Pseudo Emperor’s past body out.

He was strong, but he wasn’t strong enough that he could guarantee a victory against the Devil Pseudo Emperor. However, he was very good and experienced at time reversal. When he saw the Devil Pseudo Emperor wide open, he naturally wouldn’t let go of the chance.
“Come here! I’m hungry!” The big furball roared loudly.
When the three devil Invincibles reached him, all three attacked together. However, they all missed due to the time disorder in the area.
Inside the ancient city.
Su Yu saw the massive furball in the sky as well. When he laid eyes on the big furball, he shivered.
Holy shit!
What a big furball.

The little furball was only as big as his fist. Was that really his father? That big furball was at least a hundred times bigger than the little furball. But ignoring the size, the two were actually quite alike in appearance.
Su Yu could now be sure that the little furball was really the biological son of the big furball.

But shortly after, he looked at the little furball who had just left his sea of willpower suspiciously. The big furball had a pair of considerably long limbs. But why…was the little furball only a ball?

Yes, the big furball had reached out with his shaggy limbs to pull harder at the River of Time. He looked incredibly determined to drag his meal out of the river. At this point, the Devil Pseudo Emperor’s past body had already left the Devil Realm.
Furious, the Devil Pseudo Emperor threw a punch with the power of his present and future bodies combined. That punch of his could be seen across the entire Allheaven Battlefield.
It was a titanic punch.
At the same time, a projection appeared outside each of the realms with a Pseudo Emperor, such as the Nether, Divine, Immortal, and Dragon Realms.

Outside the Immortal Realm, Tiangu frowned. Soul devourer race. Wait…was this furball the one who had eaten his willpower earlier? No wonder he kept feeling a sense of danger. But a single Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor shouldn’t be enough to pose a threat to him even if he was a cultural researcher. How odd.

He was just contemplating that question when his expression changed. He looked at the Devil Pseudo Emperor and opened his mouth before stopping himself with an odd look in his eyes. Why should he care? This was a good thing! The Devil Pseudo Emperor was going to suffer a loss.

When the Devil Pseudo Emperor threw his punch, the big furball was still busy dragging the past body toward him. It was clear this effort was taking a lot out of him. Alone, it was unlikely that he would be able to do much to the Devil Pseudo Emperor.
Just as everyone was focused on the Devil Pseudo Emperor and the big furball, a second furball appeared near the other end of the river. The second furball opened her mouth wide and took a bite.
A loud creak rang out. It could be heard throughout the Allheaven Battlefield.
The female furball had appeared.
With one bite, she severed the river, disconnecting the portion inside the Devil Realm from the portion outside the realm. Then, she yelled in joy, “Husband, you eat there and I’ll eat here!”
“Sure.”
Chomp! Chomp! Chomp!
The two started eating from two different directions. For the very first time since the start of this incident, the Devil Pseudo Emperor’s expression changed.
There were two of them! How? How could there be two Pseudo Emperors in the soul devourer race?
“Damn it! You’re courting death!”
The Devil Pseudo Emperor rushed out of the severed end of the River of Time before throwing a punch at the furball in front of him.

The big furball was about to be sent flying when he chomped down to stop himself from flying. The Devil Pseudo Emperor grimaced as he ignored the pain he was feeling and threw a few more punches. But at that moment, a massive mouth appeared from his back.
The big furball also charged forth before taking another bite. “His main body is out as well! Let’s eat!”
All three bodies of the Devil Pseudo Emperor were out of the Devil Realm. Not even the big furball had expected this to happen. What a great opportunity for a feast.

The Devil Pseudo Emperor roared and turned around to throw another punch. Alas, he was attacked from both sides. In fact, the female furball was relentlessly targeting his sea of willpower, annoying him to no end.
There were two of them! Damn it! Why were there two of them?
“Divine Emperor, Immortal Emperor…”
He bellowed for help. He could feel that he was in trouble.
Meanwhile, the auras of the other two Pseudo Emperors started undulating. Tiangu’s voice rang out as he chided, “Soul devourers! What is this audacity? Retreat immediately!”
He only moved his mouth. Nothing else. The Divine Emperor did the same. After berating the furballs with his mouth, he did nothing.
Go, go ahead and eat.
They would be more than happy to see the Devil Pseudo Emperor turning into furball food. After all, the devil race was quite powerful.
The Devil Pseudo Emperor understood what they were thinking. He roared as his surroundings were set aflame. Then, he drew a spear out of nowhere and swept it at the big furball.
The big furball was sent flying, which infuriated the female furball. In her fury, she transformed into an even bigger ball before chomping down at the Devil Pseudo Emperor’s sea of willpower.
A creak rang out as a splitting headache assaulted the Devil Pseudo Emperor. When he turned to stab the female furball with his spear, the big furball returned.
He wanted to split his body to face both opponents at the same time, but he was wary of the risk. Splitting his body would weaken him, allowing the two furballs to really turn him into food.
But it was also extremely hard to deal with two Pseudo Emperors who were attacking from two different directions. He wouldn’t fear them in the Devil Realm. Alas, he was no longer in the Devil Realm.
“Damn it!”

He unleashed a flame attack, burning space itself apart. But the flame attack only lasted for a split second before it was eaten by the big furball with one bite. As though to taunt him, the furball even belched with satisfaction after eating the flame.
Left with no choice, the Devil Pseudo Emperor split himself. Since no help was coming, he could only rely on himself.
Damn those bastards!

The moment he split himself, his present body rushed toward the Devil Realm, leaving the past and future bodies to deal with the two furballs. He knew that he was in trouble, but he couldn’t risk leaving all three of his bodies in the Allheaven Battlefield or that might result in an even bigger trouble.

Even if the other Pseudo Emperors were to come, they wouldn’t necessarily be here to help. Rather, they might be looking for an opportunity to stab him in the back. His two bodies fought bitterly against the two furballs, but they were clearly disadvantaged in the fight.
The two furballs did not bother giving chase to the present body. They started chomping down at the two bodies repeatedly, cracking space itself apart as they bit down again and again.
And finally, the present body of the Devil Pseudo Emperor reached the Devil Realm with a pale and unsightly expression. Suddenly, he roared as his future body detonated itself.
The future was the strongest.
The explosion was devastating. Even space itself was rendered into nothingness. The big furball was swallowed by the explosion and vanished alongside everything in the radius of the explosion.
“Husband!”

The female furball roared anxiously. In her fury, she gave the past body another bite, tearing the body apart. The largest chunk of the body ignited its blood essence before fleeing from the female furball.

The female furball was just about to start searching for the big furball when he reappeared. But the sleepy look in his eyes was gone, replaced by fury and viciousness. He roared, “How dare you bomb me? Eat him!”
At that, the two furballs shot toward the fleeing past body.
Once again, the expression of the Devil Pseudo Emperor changed as he cursed in frustration.
Not even an explosion like that could kill the Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor.

The past body was fast, but it was not as fast as the two furballs. In the blink of an eye, the female furball caught up and started biting the past body again. A ruthless glint shone in the Devil Pseudo Emperor’s eyes as he decided to detonate his past body as well.
But before he could do so, the big furball enlarged, growing countless times bigger than before. In fact, he grew so large that it felt as though the sky had been replaced by his body.

And he continued growing until the entire sky was nothing but a large mouth. Then, the mouth bit down on the past body including the entire chunk of space around the past body. Next, deafening rumbles rang out from inside the furball’s body.
The explosion sent the big furball flying everywhere. Meanwhile, the sky turned crimson as a rain of blood started falling.
A Pseudo Emperor had lost both his tri-life bodies.
The resulting phenomenon was much larger than any phenomenon a dead Invincible could produce.
Throughout the Myriad Realms, countless people were stunned.
What was going on?
That was…too fast!

As far as they knew, the two furballs had appeared ou of nowhere before ravaging he Devil Pseudo Emperor so badly the devil abandoned his tri-life bodies to flee. Eventually, he was forced to detonate his tri-life bodies to deal with the two furballs.
Where did the two furballs come from?

The world sank into silence. Countless Invincibles appeared to stare at the two furballs. All the ongoing battles had stopped. In light of what just happened, nobody was interested in fighting anymore.
Soul devourer race?
This race was unknown to even some Invincibles.
